messages:
liz_sales: Heads up — Helios Clinic asked for our pen-test + vuln-scan package for the POC security review. They need a redacted bundle, checksums, and a proposed fix timeline. Can infra ops assemble? :eyes: 

maria_sec: Confirming scope before we assemble: full pentest PDF, Nexpose/Qualys CSV export, container SBOMs, and infra config snippets. We MUST remove any patient identifiers and customer IPs. Do we have an approved redaction pattern?

tony_sre: I can build the bundle. We'll run the redaction pipeline (redact-psi.sh) and produce a redaction_manifest.log. I’ll also fingerprint all files with sha256 and sign with our ops key. Upload target: s3://redwood-vendor-evidence/helios/2003001111/

devon_eng: For remediation SLAs, Helios asked for hard dates on "critical" items. Suggest we commit to 48hrs for true-critical (credential exposure, RCE), 5 business days for high, and 10 business days+triage for medium. Can owners meet that?

maria_sec: 48hrs is aggressive but OK if owners ack. We should differentiate "urgent" vs "critical" in the manifest and list compensating controls where immediate fix isn't available. I’ll add that section to the executive note.

tony_sre: upload-bot: starting bundle creation -> encrypting with KMS key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789

tony_sre: upload-bot: completed -> s3://redwood-vendor-evidence/helios/2003001111/helios-pt-evidence-2003001111.zip (server-side-encrypted). sha256: d61f9b2a7e6c4f8e9a1b2c3d4e5f6789a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5

tony_sre: Quick verification steps for Helios reviewer: ```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-vendor-evidence/helios/2003001111/helios-pt-evidence-2003001111.zip --expires-in 604800
curl -sSL <presigned-url> -o helios-pt-evidence.zip
sha256sum helios-pt-evidence.zip
```

maria_sec: Redaction notes: redaction_manifest.log includes masked IPs (format: X.X.X.X -> [REDACTED_IP]), removed PHI fields from logs, and an itemized list of stack traces we truncated. We also included a short README explaining the redaction rationale.

liz_sales: Can ops also produce a remediation CSV mapping vulnID -> path -> owner -> suggested ETA? Helios security asked for that mapping to import into their tracker.

devon_eng: Done. remediation_map_2003001111.csv uploaded. Owner groups: eng-runtime, eng-platform, infra-sre, product-security. I assigned tentative ETAs but marked as 'pending owner confirmation'.

maria_sec: I'll create a one-page executive summary for Helios that states scope, redaction approach, severity buckets, and our proposed SLA matrix. Will include a short section on what we will not share (billing data, PHI).

liz_sales: Also note: Helios legal requested cross-account access rather than a zip. We set up a role: arn:aws:iam::HELIOS:role/VendorEvidenceReadOnly with a 10-day expiry and logged the grant.

tony_sre: Added access log entry: evidence-bot: {"path":"s3://redwood-vendor-evidence/helios/2003001111/","uploader":"tony_sre","size":"58MB","sha256":"d61f9b2a7e6c4f8e9a1b2c3d4e5f6789a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5"} -- (full log in bucket).

maria_sec: Can we schedule a 45-min triage with Helios Sec to walk through criticals and confirm owners? I'm available Wed 9am PT or Thu 1pm PT. Liz, can you propose?

liz_sales: I'll propose Wed 9am PT. Also will attach the exec summary to the calendar invite and include the remediation_map CSV.

devon_eng: Final action items: (1) owners to confirm ETAs in remediation_map_2003001111.csv by EOD tomorrow, (2) maria_sec to publish exec summary and redaction statement, (3) tony_sre to confirm cross-account role and retention policy.

tony_sre: Retention: artifacts retained 21 days in the evidence bucket, then lifecycle to Glacier Deep Archive. We can extend on request.

evidence-bot: thread metadata: upload_complete=true; retention_days=21; presigned_url_expiry=864000; owner_confirmation_deadline=2003087511

liz_sales: Thanks team — once owners confirm I'll send the presigned URL + checksum and proposed meeting time to Helios Sec.

maria_sec: Acknowledged, will tag owners in the CSV and follow up.

evidence-bot: thread closed for edits at 2003001899
